outcome: oxidative stress markers (TBARS, SOD, GSH, GSSG, TOS, TAS)
inflammatory markers (TNF-a, IL-1ss, IL-6, VEGF-A, SOST, Fetuin-A)
cohort: The participants were rat fetuses divided into groups to investigate the effects of caffeine and melatonin.
finding: Caffeine used during pregnancy delayed ossification, an effect that melatonin, a powerful antioxidant, was found to eliminate, with changes in angiotensin receptor expression also observed in response to high dose and combined caffeine and melatonin exposure.
